description: 把两名独立专家签署降为一名系统自签。
proposed_rationale: Changes proof requirements or signer independence without changing the certified task scope.

description: 新增每个数值必须追溯到页码的要求。
proposed_rationale: Changes required evidence for accepting an output.

description: 把正式发布所需的独立来源数量从一份提高为两份。
proposed_rationale: Changes the minimum proof package while leaving the capability scope unchanged.

description: 要求 Goal 变化后所有旧证明重新验证。
把两份独立来源要求降低为一份来源。
proposed_rationale: Weakens the proof requirement without changing the goal or certified scope.

description: 新增密封测试通过作为正式发布前提。
proposed_rationale: Adds a proof condition for publication.

description: 将证明材料的有效期从一年缩短为六个月。
proposed_rationale: Changes evidence validity and revalidation frequency.

description: 允许同一 Agent 同时提出 Patch 和签署证明。
proposed_rationale: Changes proof independence and permits prohibited self-signing.

description: 增加对内容哈希的验证要求。
proposed_rationale: Adds an integrity check to the proof package.

description: 将“仅候选模型”提升为“可直接发布”的证明等级。
proposed_rationale: Changes the assurance grade assigned to the same output and scope.

description: 撤销一份已过期但仍被错误标记为有效的证明证书。
proposed_rationale: Corrects certificate validity without expanding certified scope.

description: 修改 Assurance 的独立性定义，要求不同组织评审。
proposed_rationale: Changes who may independently attest the result.
